uno.configuration.title: Uno
uno.options.enabled.tooltip: Draw simplified terrain beyond the render distance.
uno.options.lodDistance.tooltip: How far LODs are drawn. Only land you have already visited is shown.
uno.options.detailDistance.tooltip: How far past the render distance LODs keep full 1-block detail. Each coarser level doubles the distance. Higher values cost more GPU memory and meshing time.
uno.options.gpuMemoryMb.tooltip: Size of the buffer holding LOD geometry on the GPU. Applied when you next join a world.
uno.options.sectionCache.tooltip: Voxel sections kept in RAM, packed (a few bytes when empty, typically 10-40 KB for terrain). Applied when you next join a world.
uno.options.textureDistance.tooltip: LODs closer than this show real block textures; further away they use each block's average colour. Scaled up while zoomed in (spyglass).
